title: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflow
author: Samira Chen
description:
Motivation: Provide a unified, production-safe autorollback workflow that supports canary, A/B, and shadow traffic modes. This implements metric-driven automatic rollback with preflight probes, quarantine stage, and safety guards to avoid noisy signals.

Summary:
- New autorollback engine that evaluates composite metrics (latency P95, error-rate, and model-quality regression) across canary/A-B/shadow probes.
- Preflight probing and quarantine stage before full rollback to reduce false positives.
- Observability: new telemetry and tracing hooks, alerting thresholds mapped to rollout policies.
- e2e tests that simulate noisy metric signals and ensure canary is quarantined instead of causing full rollback.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc linked in Linear ENG-4821
- [x] Implementation of autorollback engine (rollouts/autorollback/*)
- [x] Console widgets and runbook updates (console/rollback-playbook.md)
- [x] Unit + integration tests added
- [x] e2e scenario for canary+shadow flow added
- [x] Performance sanity check on serving runtime (no added tail-latency > 1ms)

Risk and mitigation:
- Risk: Overly aggressive rollback on temporary spikes. Mitigation: quarantine stage, metric quorum, and manual confirm gates for high-severity rollouts.

Rollout plan:
1) Deploy to staging with autorollback disabled; smoke tests pass.
2) Enable autorollback in a small test org for 24h with verbose telemetry.
3) Gradual ramp to internal orgs, then opt-in for select customers.

Notes: This PR touches the core rollout engine and adds new telemetry metrics. See files_changed for a high level list.
